remarks:
Cassadaga Lake! Beautifully renovated 2BR/1 Bath year-round home with 65 feet of prime lake frontage, your own private boat ramp, and dock! Completely renovated inside and out, this inviting home features an open great-room design with a spacious living/dining area flowing into the modern kitchen, complete with range and refrigerator. Convenient first-floor laundry area with washer and dryer included, located near the side entrance. Attached two-car garage provides plenty of storage and convenience. Exterior features include durable metal roof and siding, gated entrance, and spacious blacktop driveway. Additional updates include 200-amp circuit breaker service and a gas-fired tankless hot water heater. Enjoy lakefront living, boating, kayaking, fishing, and beautiful Cassadaga Lake views right from your own property!
Unique opportunity: The neighboring home at 16 Lakeview Avenue, offered at $399,900, may be purchased together with this property at a discounted combined price of $629,900—an incredible $50,000 savings!
